evidence.claim: Built in 1898, it served as an LDS meetinghouse and a school, with classroom use ending in 1917 and religious meetings in 1928.
evidence.quote: The Torrey Log Church–Schoolhouse was built in Torrey, Utah in 1898 as an LDS meetinghouse and schoolhouse. The one storey log structure served as the school until 1917, and as a meetinghouse until 1928.
